facts.fact: PATNuC describes the e-Gov reform, examined at the Ebolowa 2025 workshop, as providing that administrations must make their information systems compatible, with GovTech Cameroun setting security and interoperability norms; it does not state that the law has been adopted (published 2025-11-20, no other date given).

systems.system: Plateforme nationale unifiée (point d'accès unique aux services publics numériques)
